episodes.title: Le journal du matin, lundi 23 novembre
episodes.headline_en: The head of state, Emmanuel Macron, is considering writing a budgetary golden rule into the Constitution, according to Le Figaro and Le Monde
summary_en: The head of state, Emmanuel Macron, is considering writing a budgetary golden rule into the Constitution, according to Le Figaro and Le Monde
The COP31 climate conference ended in Antalya, Turkey, without a final agreement, according to franceinfo; Libération quotes Laurence Tubiana on multilateralism
The Choose France summit, devoted to French companies, takes place on Monday; Le Monde writes it aims to showcase 42.5 billion euros of investment by French companies

episodes.title: Le sport, lundi 23 novembre
episodes.headline_en: The XV de France face South Africa in the Nations Championship final next Sunday, at Twickenham according to franceinfo, kick-off 5:40 pm according to L'Équipe and Ouest-France
summary_en: The XV de France face South Africa in the Nations Championship final next Sunday, at Twickenham according to franceinfo, kick-off 5:40 pm according to L'Équipe and Ouest-France
Thomas Ramos is in the group of 42 players called up to prepare the Nations Championship final, Ouest-France and L'Équipe write

episodes.title: La météo, lundi 23 novembre
episodes.headline_en: Météo-France lifts the orange rain-and-flood vigilance for the Ain and the Jura but keeps orange alerts for river floods in the Pas-de-Calais and for wind in Corsica, Ouest-France writes
summary_en: Météo-France lifts the orange rain-and-flood vigilance for the Ain and the Jura but keeps orange alerts for river floods in the Pas-de-Calais and for wind in Corsica, Ouest-France writes
Marseille today: partly cloudy, 10 to 14 degrees, wind up to 33 km/h, per the Météo-France models
